Bloomberg.t: ETF Launches Blow Past IPOs: Slavin

Bloomberg.t: Lula Worries Slam Brazil Markets From Real to Corporate Bonds

Bloomberg.t: Fed's Hammack Prefers Moving Rates in Smaller Increments
